commit_policy: metadata-first; remote resource bodies are not downloaded

normalisation.publisher_authority: publisher records are canonical concepts keyed by publisher.name and concept_id

deferred_loads.analysis_overview: loaded by the generic OKF Explorer for overview graph, links, timeline, facets, and resources before full hydration
deferred_loads.dataset_index: loaded only after filters, detail routes, or non-overview views that need full records
deferred_loads.relationships: loaded only when Graph mode is opened
deferred_loads.resources: loaded with the full index because resource details and resource-type filters need it
deferred_loads.search: loads data/search/manifest.json plus only the lexicon, postings, and result-doc chunks needed by the query

title: GOV.UK CKAN OKF Bundle
